hotel.name: TA’AKTANA, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Labuan Bajo

verified_facts.text: The resort is on Pantai Wae Rana in Labuan Bajo, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pantai Wae Rana, Labuan Bajo, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, 86763

verified_facts.text: The resort spans 16 hectares between lush forests and the shores of the Flores Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cradled between lush forests and the pearlescent shores of the Flores Sea, TA’AKTANA spans 16 hectares of unspoiled paradise.

verified_facts.text: The resort's design is inspired by the Lingko fields and their spider web-shaped rice terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the Lingko fields and their spider web-shaped rice terraces, our Indonesia luxury resort is a living testament to Labuan Bajo’s unique heritage.

verified_facts.text: Overwater Sea Villas float above the water and feature macrame artwork of neighboring islands and marine life, phinisi boat relics and a carpet inspired by Pink Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floating above the pristine waters, these villas echo the legacy of the Bajo seafarers, featuring macrame artwork depicting neighboring islands and marine life adorning the headboard, phinisi boat relics, a gradient carpet inspired by Pink Beach

verified_facts.text: Overwater Sea Villas have a freestanding bathtub with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: a freestanding bathtub with uninterrupted ocean views.

verified_facts.text: One-Bedroom Villas have a private terrace and pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: A tranquil hideaway with a private terrace and pool, designed for those seeking seclusion and serenity.

verified_facts.text: The three-bedroom Mansion has two living spaces, indoor and outdoor dining areas, a private infinity pool and a terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: A pinnacle of exclusivity, with two living spaces, indoor and outdoor dining areas for epicurean experiences, a private infinity pool, and a sun-drenched terrace.

verified_facts.text: Every villa comes with 24/7 butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every villa is accompanied by a 24/7 Butler service

verified_facts.text: At turndown, guests find a handcrafted traditional lantern in their suite or villa, a symbol of the Manggarai people.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests will find a handcrafted traditional lantern in their suite or villa – a symbol of the Manggarai people, once used to guide villagers through the night.

verified_facts.text: Di'a Spa is inspired by the sacred caves of Rangko and Batu Cermin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the sacred caves of Rangko and Batu Cermin, this tranquil retreat cocoons guests in a world of natural stillness

verified_facts.text: The wellness center has hot and cold plunge pools and six treatment rooms inspired by nearby caves.
verified_facts.excerpt: hot and cold plunge pools, and six textured treatment rooms inspired by nearby caves

verified_facts.text: Dives depart from the resort's private jetty to sites developed by its Marine Specialist Team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Departing from our private jetty, follow the call of the ocean to sites personally developed by our distinguished Marine Specialist Team

verified_facts.text: Island-hopping trips sail into Komodo National Park, where guests can see Komodo dragons in their natural habitat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set sail into the legendary waters of Komodo National Park amidst emerald peaks and azure seas, where encounters with the mythical Komodo dragon in their natural habitat make for stories that last a lifetime.

verified_facts.text: Private yacht trips come with a dedicated butler, a personalized itinerary and a gourmet beachside picnic.
verified_facts.excerpt: embark on a private yacht adventure, where a dedicated butler, personalized itinerary, and a gourmet beachside picnic transform island-hopping

verified_facts.text: The resort has an Olympic-sized swimming pool, a Kids Club and an overwater bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you prefer lounging by the Olympic-sized swimming pool, treating young ones to new adventures at the Kids Club, or reveling in breathtaking sunsets from the overwater bar

verified_facts.text: A sprawling beachside pool for all ages has a swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: a sprawling beachside pool for all ages, with a swim-up bar and plenty of loungers

verified_facts.text: Kids Club activities include Bajo canvas painting, Manggarian storytelling and Rangku Alu dance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids Club offers several unique activities: Bajo canvas painting, seed for tomorrow, Manggarian storytelling, Rangku Alu dance, and many more.

verified_facts.text: Family villas have a second bedroom for children with sea-themed wallpaper and a lofted play area.
verified_facts.excerpt: family villas in which the second bedroom is tyke-oriented with cute sea-themed wallpaper and a lofted play area

verified_facts.text: At Nera Lounge, the Sunset Ritual is a complimentary cocktail infused with local botanicals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrate this fleeting beauty with our Sunset Ritual—a complimentary cocktail infused with local botanicals, reflecting the twilight glow.

verified_facts.text: Maiga! is a bar located on the jetty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the jetty, our bar in Labuan Bajo draws those in search of a vibrant, social adventure.

verified_facts.text: Produce comes from Kebunku, the resort's on-site chef's garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: vibrant produce handpicked from Kebunku, our on-site chef’s garden

verified_facts.text: Land tours visit Melo Village, a traditional Manggarai settlement with conical thatched houses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wander through a traditional Manggarai settlement and visit Melo Village, where conical thatched houses stand as a testament to time-honored craftsmanship.

verified_facts.text: Kayaks and stand-up paddleboards are available at the oversea activity center.
verified_facts.excerpt: the oversea activity center where kayaks and SUPs are available to paddle between pylons over starfish, sea anemone, clownfish and maybe hawksbill sea turtles

verified_facts.text: The resort's Dayara Boat is a Leopard 53 with indoor lounges and open decks.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Dayara Boat – a majestic Leopard 53 – is a confluence of modern engineering and elegant design. With plush indoor lounges and open decks for reveling in sunsets

verified_facts.text: Komodo Airport (LBJ) is about 2.5 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: LBJ is located approximately 2.5 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 17.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 17

verified_facts.text: The resort is Green Globe Certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: Green Globe Certified

subjective.text: The resort is described as a utopian Indonesian beach resort.
subjective.reason: the hotel's own opinion or praise; keep out of facts
